meta.title: Codorah | Take your business digital, the simple way
meta.description: Codorah helps businesses, shops and organizations in Togo and across Africa go digital: websites, apps, management tools, automation and training.

hero.description: Website, app, management tools, automation: Codorah guides you from idea to launch with solutions that are easy to use and built around your business.

about.title: Digital tools that help your business grow
about.subtitle: Save time, reach more customers, run your business with clarity: we turn your real needs into simple, effective tools.
about.imageAlt: Team working on a digital project

items.title: Save time
items.desc: Automate repetitive tasks and focus on what really matters.

items.title: Reach more customers
items.desc: Be visible online and available to your customers anytime, anywhere.

items.title: Stay in control
items.desc: Track sales, stock and activity at a glance to make better decisions.

services.title: Everything you need to go digital successfully
services.subtitle: We recommend the solution that best fits your goals and budget, then build it together with you.

items.title: Websites & online stores
items.description: A professional website to showcase your business, build trust and sell online, with mobile money payments if needed.
items.imageAlt: Website displayed on desktop and mobile

items.title: Web & mobile apps
items.description: An app that reflects your brand to serve customers, manage bookings or launch a new service.

items.title: Process digitalization
items.description: Replace notebooks and spreadsheets with tailor-made management tools: stock, invoicing, customers, staff.

items.title: Automation & artificial intelligence
items.description: Virtual assistants, automatic WhatsApp replies, document processing: AI that helps you every day.

items.title: Brand identity & digital design
items.description: Logo, brand guidelines, mockups and interfaces: a modern, consistent image across all your channels.

items.title: Hosting, security & maintenance
items.description: We launch, protect and maintain your tools so you can stay worry-free after go-live.
items.imageAlt: Security and maintenance of digital tools

projects.title: Platforms designed and launched by Codorah
projects.subtitle: Education, tourism, finance, agriculture, training: real projects, live today, built for the realities of Togo and West Africa.

items.name: EduFast
items.description: Learning platform for francophone Africa: exam preparation (CEPD, BEPC, BAC), a 24/7 AI tutor, offline courses and progress reports sent to parents on WhatsApp.

items.name: HeriToGo
items.description: Digital guide to Togo's heritage: sites and monuments, tourist regions, local cuisine and guides, with an AI scanner that recognizes a monument from a photo.

items.name: eganyé
items.tagline: The digital tontine, simple and safe.
items.description: Digital tontine for West Africa: create your savings circle, contribute via Mobile Money and follow every payout round transparently.

items.name: AgroCapital
items.tagline: The right price for your harvest.
items.description: Connects Togolese farmers to the digital marketplace: sell at the right time with price tracking, get cash advances on harvest stock and get paid via Mobile Money.

items.name: EIA Togo
items.tagline: The aviation school where your dreams take off.
items.description: Website of the International Aviation School in Lomé: aviation and maritime training programs, admissions, fees and online applications.

items.name: EasyChin
items.description: Business platform connecting China and Africa to make trade and sourcing simpler.
